messages:
elaine: Morning — planning a small pricing page experiment next week: update FAQs, test new tier names, add inline metered estimator, and tie a webinar CTA to mid-funnel. Want quick sync on rollout + tracking.

mateo: love it. what's the primary hypothesis?

elaine: hypothesis: clearer tier names + a focused estimator reduces contact form starts but increases self-serve signups; webinar CTA should capture higher-intent leads for Dedicated/Private.

jess: for tier names, can we try "Starter / Scale / Enterprise" vs "Developer / Production / Dedicated"? which variant is current?

sam (growth): current is "Starter / Team /Scale". propose variant A: "Dev / Prod / Enterprise" (short labels); variant B: "Pay-as-you-go / Reserved / Private" (functional).

pranay: legal flag: "Private" might imply features; prefer "Private Deployment" in small caps. Also need to check privacy claim language in FAQ.

elaine: noted. tagging design for microcopy: @jess @mateo — can you draft two header lines per variant? keep CTA consistent.

mateo: I'll push two hero lines by EOD. also suggest changing estimator UI copy: "Estimate monthly inference cost" -> "Estimate monthly inference cost for your usage". shorter?

sam (growth): tracking: plan A/B test on tier names via client-side experiment. events: pricing_view, estimator_open, estimator_submit, cta_webinar_click, contact_form_start, signup_complete.

sam (growth): send snippet for analytics:

```json
{
 "event": "estimator_submit",
 "props": { "model_family": "llama2", "sequence_length": 1024, "qps": 5 }
}
```

jess: quick UX note — the calculator needs to handle burst vs sustained QPS. show toggle.

pranay: FAQ updates: add Q on "Can I reserve capacity?" and "How is pricing metered?" I'll draft answers. also add compliance bullet for Private.

elaine: rollout plan: week 1 — implement copy + estimator UI behind feature flag; launch A/B test with 50/50 tier names; week 2 — webinar promo variant on 25% traffic; route webinar signups into sales: webhook -> HubSpot. owner: @sam (growth) for tracking, @jess for design, @pranay for legal/FAQ.

sam (growth): routing: webinar form -> hubspot list "Pricing Webinar Leads". add hidden field "variant": ab_group.

jess: mockups in figma at https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/pricing-estimator — will update components.

mateo: small experiment: show mini FAQ accordion on hero vs full FAQ lower down. can we test placement? prefer hero for high friction. thoughts?

elaine: yes test both. metric: contact_form_start down, signup_complete up, webinar CTR up for high-intent.

pranay: legal review ETA 48h once copy is in doc. tag me.

sam (growth): also add UTM param for webinar CTA: ?utm_campaign=pricing_playbook&utm_source=site

elaine: thank you — I'll create the feature flag + PR checklist. ping me when mockups done. :thumbsup:
